name: Loudly
tagline: A louder, cleaner player for your own music and videos — offline, bought once, no subscription.
storage_summary: The music and videos you import, your playlists, favourites and settings are stored only on your iPhone. Loudly works fully offline and never sends your data anywhere.
nothing_sent_detail: Your audio is boosted and equalised on your iPhone. Purchases are handled by Apple through the App Store; we never see your payment details.
stored_on_device: The audio and video files you import (from Files, AirDrop or your music library) and your library, playlists and favourites.
Your boost, equaliser and playback settings, and the results of the Volume Checkup.
Whether you have unlocked Loudly Plus, checked on your device with Apple's StoreKit.
Delete everything at any time by deleting the app.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account, because Loudly has no sign-in.
What you listen to or watch, because nothing about your library or playback leaves your iPhone.
Your advertising identifier (IDFA), location, contacts or browsing history.
Analytics or crash reports, because the app includes no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDK and makes no network requests.
Payment details, because purchases are processed by Apple.

permissions.name: Media & Apple Music
permissions.why: to let you pick songs already in your music library (DRM-free tracks only), only if you choose to import from it. The songs stay on your iPhone.

your_controls: **Remove any track or video** from your Loudly library in the app; the original file in Files or your music library is not touched.
**Revoke Media & Apple Music access** in iOS Settings at any time; files you imported from Files keep working.
**Delete all your data** by deleting the app.

support_faq.q: Can Loudly make Spotify, YouTube or Apple Music louder?
support_faq.a: No. iOS does not let any app process another app's audio, so no app can truly do this. Loudly boosts the music and videos you import into Loudly itself, and its **Volume Checkup** shows the iOS settings that may be making your iPhone quieter everywhere.

support_faq.q: How much louder does it get, and will it distort?
support_faq.a: Loudly applies a real, measured boost with a built-in limiter, so loud passages are held back instead of clipping. The exact boost depends on the track; very loud masters gain less.

support_faq.q: I bought Loudly Plus. How do I get it on a new iPhone?
support_faq.a: Loudly Plus is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Open the Loudly Plus screen and tap **Restore Purchases** while signed in with the same Apple Account you used to buy.

support_faq.q: How do I add my music and videos?
support_faq.a: Import files from the Files app or AirDrop, or pick DRM-free songs from your music library. Streaming-service downloads and protected songs cannot be imported because they are locked to their own apps.

support_faq.q: How do I get a refund?
support_faq.a: Refunds are handled by Apple. Request one at [reportaproblem.apple.com](https://reportaproblem.apple.com).

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Remove tracks in the app, or delete the app. Your files and settings live only on your iPhone, so deleting the app removes them completely.
